data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for creating localized polls with Material 3 styling.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fully controlled poll UI that displays options, voting results, and countdown timers. Supports multiple languages via built‑in locales and custom labels. Uses Material 3 Expressive design by default.
use_when: you need a ready‑made poll interface in a Flutter app
you want built‑in localization for poll labels and time remaining
you prefer an immutable, declarative widget API
avoid_when: you require complex backend voting logic integrated in the widget
you need custom charting or non‑poll UI components
your app runs on Flutter versions older than 3.47
strengths: Material 3 Expressive look with easy style overrides
immutable, fully controlled API reduces side effects
weaknesses: only provides poll UI, no networking or data persistence
requires Flutter 3.47+ and the material_ui package
limited customization beyond provided style options
